75858-the-strange-countess.title: Strange Countess
75858-the-strange-countess.creator: Edgar Wallace
75858-the-strange-countess.description: A book by Edgar Wallace. “You’ve been a darling,” she said, “and in many ways I’m sorry I’m going. But, Lizzy, I’ve tried hard to move on all my life. From the National School in Leeds to that little cash desk at Roopers, and from Roopers to the Drug Stores, and then to the great lawyers----”

arxiv-2202-04896.title: Faulty isogenies: a new kind of leakage
arxiv-2202-04896.creator: Gora Adj, Jesús-Javier Chi-Domínguez, Víctor Mateu, Francisco Rodríguez-Henríquez
arxiv-2202-04896.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Gora Adj, Jesús-Javier Chi-Domínguez, Víctor Mateu, Francisco Rodríguez-Henríquez. In SIDH and SIKE protocols, public keys are defined over quadratic extensions of prime fields. We present in this work a projective invariant property characterizing affine Montgomery curves defined over prime fields.

arxiv-2208-12783.title: Relationships between cumulative entropy/extropy, Gini mean difference and probability weighted moments Thanks: † Corresponding author E-mail: skkattu@isichennai.res.in .
arxiv-2208-12783.creator: Sudheesh K. Kattumannil a,† , Sreedevi, E. P. b and N. Balakrishnan c a Indian Statistical Institute, Chennai, India, b Maharaja’s College, Eranakulam, India, c McMaster University, Hamilton, Canada
arxiv-2208-12783.description: Abstract . In this work, we establish a connection between the cumulative residual entropy and the Gini mean difference (GMD). Some relationships between the extropy and the GMD, and the truncated GMD and dynamic versions of the cumulative extropy are also established.

arxiv-2411-03222.title: A resolved Ly α \alpha profile with doubly peaked emission at z ∼ 7 z\sim 7
arxiv-2411-03222.creator: C. Moya-Sierralta, J. González-López, L. Infante, L. F. Barrientos, W. Hu, S. Malhotra, J. Rhoads, J. Wang, I. Wold, Z. Zheng
arxiv-2411-03222.description: Abstract Context. The epoch of reionization is a landmark in structure formation and galaxy evolution. How it happened is still not clear, especially regarding which population of objects was responsible for contributing the bulk of ionizing photons toward this process.

arxiv-2412-16858.title: Cosmic ray spectra and anisotropy under anisotropic propagation model with spiral galactic sources
arxiv-2412-16858.creator: Aifeng Li, Zhaodong Lv, Wei Liu *, Yiqing Guo *, Fangheng Zhang
arxiv-2412-16858.description: Abstract In our previous work, we have investigated Galactic cosmic ray (GCR) spectra and anisotropy from 100 GeV to PeV, under anisotropic propagation model with axisymmetric distributed galactic sources. Numerous observational evidence have indicated that the Milky Way is a typical spiral galaxy.

arxiv-2510-13649.title: Local-Global Context-Aware and Structure-Preserving Image Super-Resolution
arxiv-2510-13649.creator: Sanchar Palit, Subhasis Chaudhuri, Biplab Banerjee
arxiv-2510-13649.description: Abstract Diffusion models have recently achieved significant success in various image manipulation tasks, including image super-resolution and perceptual quality enhancement. Pretrained text-to-image models, such as Stable Diffusion, have exhibited strong capabilities in synthesizing realistic image content, which makes them particularly attractive for addressing super-resolution tasks.

arxiv-2511-20628.title: Routing in Non-Isotonic Quantum Networks 1 Maxwell Tang and Garrett Hinkley contributed equally to this work. We thank Eva Peet for help with creating Fig. 2 . S.K. and G.A. acknowledge support from NSF CQN Grant No. 1941583, NSF Grant No. 2346089, and NSF Grant No. 2402861. K.G. acknowledges suppor
arxiv-2511-20628.creator: Maxwell Tang 2 1 , Garrett Hinkley 2 1 , Kenneth Goodenough 2 3 , Stefan Krastanov 2 , Guus Avis 2
arxiv-2511-20628.description: Abstract Optimal routing in quantum-repeater networks requires finding the best path that connects a pair of end nodes. Most previous work on routing in quantum networks assumes utility functions that are isotonic, meaning that the ordering of two paths does not change when extending both with the same edge.

arxiv-2512-00290.title: EduEval: A Hierarchical Cognitive Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Chinese Education
arxiv-2512-00290.creator: Guoqing Ma, Jia Zhu, Hanghui Guo, Weijie Shi, Yue Cui, Jiawei Shen, Zilong Li, Yidan Liang, [0.5em] Zhejiang Normal University, Zhejiang, China
arxiv-2512-00290.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate significant potential for educational applications. However, their unscrutinized deployment poses risks to educational standards, underscoring the need for rigorous evaluation. We introduce EduEval, a comprehensive hierarchical benchmark for evaluating LLMs in Chinese K-12 education.

arxiv-2512-09091.title: Local Banach Space Theoretic Approach to Bohr’s Theorem for Vector Valued Holomorphic and Pluriharmonic Functions
arxiv-2512-09091.creator: Himadri Halder
arxiv-2512-09091.description: Abstract . We study Bohr’s theorem for vector valued holomorphic and operator valued pluriharmonic functions on complete Reinhardt domains in ℂ n \mathbb{C}^{n} . Using invariants from local Banach space theory, we show that the associated Bohr radius is always strictly positive and obtain its asymptotic behavior separately in the finite- and infinite-dimensional settings.

pmc-10597990.title: Nucleophosmin 1 cooperates with BRD4 to facilitate c-Myc transcription to promote prostate cancer progression
pmc-10597990.creator: Zhe Hong, Chengdang Xu, Shengfeng Zheng, Xinan Wang, Yiran Tao, Yao Tan, Guowen Lin, Denglong Wu, Dingwei Ye
pmc-10597990.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Nucleophosmin 1 (NPM1) is a multifunctional protein that promotes tumor progression in various cancers and is associated with a poor prognosis of prostate cancer (PCa). However, the mechanism by which NPM1 exerts its malignant potential in PCa remains elusive. Here, we showed that NPM1 is overexpressed in PCa cell lines and tissues and that the dysregulation of NPM1 promotes PCa proliferation.

pmc-12467523.title: Integrated Fluidic Platform for Washing and Mechanical Processing of Lipoaspirate for Downstream Fat Grafting and Regenerative Applications
pmc-12467523.creator: David Zalazar, Jiayi Feng, Derek A Banyard, Marzieh Aliaghaei, Alan D Widgerow, Jered B Haun, Steven Paul Nistico
pmc-12467523.description: Autologous fat grafting of human lipoaspirate (LA) is increasingly used in reconstructive and cosmetic surgery for lipofilling and stem cell-rich “nanofat” reinjection for regenerative medicine. While commercial devices (e.g., REVOLVE and Puregraft) are available, many surgeons use non-standardized manual washing techniques, leading to inconsistent graft retention (20–80%).

pmc-12646340.title: The effects of purslane consumption on blood pressure in adults: A grading of recommendations, assessment, development, and evaluation-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-12646340.creator: Mahdi Vajdi, Negin Tahvilian, Shirin Hassanizadeh, Malihe Jafari, Gholamreza Askari
pmc-12646340.description: Background:Results from different studies on the effects of purslane consumption on blood pressure (BP) are still debated. To fill this knowledge gap, we investigated the overall effects of purslane consumption on systolic BP (SBP) and diastolic BP (DBP).Materials and Methods:A comprehensive literature search was conducted on Scopus, Web of Science, PubMed, Google Scholar, and Cochrane databases.

pmc-12698596.title: Different degrees of expression of pulmonary fibrosis signs with intratracheal administration of bleomycin at different doses in male SD rats (a study aimed at helping to select the optimal bleomycin dose for modeling pulmonary fibrosis)
pmc-12698596.creator: Elena A. Tukhovskaya, Yulia A. Palikova, Maria S. Severyukhina, Alina M. Ismailova, Victor Palikov, Gulsara A. Slashcheva, Natalya A. Borozdina, Evgeniy S. Mikhaylov, Irina N. Kravchenko, Vitaly Kazakov, Ekaterina N. Kazakova, Elena A. Kalabina, Ekaterina A. Rasskazova, Vladimir A. Rykov, Olga Patsa
pmc-12698596.description: BackgroundPulmonary fibrosis (PF) is a life-threatening lung disease. PF develops under the influence of various damaging agents. To study new therapeutic strategies, a PF model with intratracheal administration of bleomycin (BLM) is used.MethodsWe studied the effect of different doses of BLM. The study was performed on male SD rats. BLM was administrated at doses of 0.5, 1.5, 2.

pmc-13621665.title: Clinical characteristics of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and its association with significant liver fibrosis in hospitalized patients with chronic hepatitis B: a single-center retrospective cross-sectional study
pmc-13621665.creator: Chun-Xia Wang, Jun Kang, Jia-Wei Zhang, Xiao-Yan Yuan, Dong Wang, Mao-Quan Li, Da-Feng Liu
pmc-13621665.description: BackgroundCoexistence of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is becoming more common in clinical settings, but the relationship between MASLD and significant liver fibrosis in CHB remains uncertain.AimTo delineate the clinical profile of hospitalized CHB patients with concomitant MASLD and investigate the relationship of MASLD with significant liver fibrosis.
